recipes.name: Paprika & lime chicken rice bowl with broccoli
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Cut the broccoli into small florets, adding a splash of water to steam-fry it. Heat half the oil in a wide pan and cook the vegetables until tender. Transfer to a plate.
Slice and fry the chicken in the remaining oil until the centre holds 75°C for 30 seconds.
Return the vegetables to the pan. Stir in the smoked paprika, warm for 30 seconds, then take off the heat and squeeze in the lime.
Spoon the topping over the rice.

Cut the carrot into fine matchsticks. Heat half the oil in a wide pan and cook the vegetables until tender. Transfer to a plate.
Slice and fry the chicken in the remaining oil until the centre holds 75°C for 30 seconds.
Return the vegetables to the pan. Grate the ginger and stir it into the passata. Simmer the sauce for 5 minutes.
Toss through the pasta with the reserved cooking water.

Cut the broccoli into small florets, adding a splash of water to steam-fry it. Heat half the oil in a wide pan and cook the vegetables until tender. Transfer to a plate.
Slice and fry the chicken in the remaining oil until the centre holds 75°C for 30 seconds.
Return the vegetables to the pan. Simmer with the coconut milk for 5 minutes, then finish off the heat with lime juice.
Spoon the topping over the bulgur.

Slice the courgette into thin half-moons. Heat half the oil in a wide pan and cook the vegetables until tender. Transfer to a plate.
Sear the beef strips in the remaining oil until cooked through.
Return the vegetables to the pan. Crush the garlic into the pan, stir for 30 seconds, then pour in the passata and simmer for 5 minutes.
Toss through the pasta with the reserved cooking water.

Rinse the spinach and shake it dry. Heat half the oil in a wide pan and cook the vegetables until tender. Transfer to a plate.
Sear the beef strips in the remaining oil until cooked through.
Return the vegetables to the pan. Take the pan off the heat and toss the filling with lemon juice and dried basil.
Fold the noodles through the pan and serve hot.

recipes.name: Paprika & lime beef couscous bowl with broccoli
steps: Prepare the couscous with boiling water as directed on the packet, then fluff it with a fork.
Cut the broccoli into small florets, adding a splash of water to steam-fry it. Heat half the oil in a wide pan and cook the vegetables until tender. Transfer to a plate.
Sear the beef strips in the remaining oil until cooked through.
Return the vegetables to the pan. Stir in the smoked paprika, warm for 30 seconds, then take off the heat and squeeze in the lime.
Serve the topping over the couscous.

Cut the broccoli into small florets, adding a splash of water to steam-fry it. Heat half the oil in a wide pan and cook the vegetables until tender. Transfer to a plate.
Sear the beef strips in the remaining oil until cooked through.
Return the vegetables to the pan. Take the pan off the heat and toss the filling with lemon juice and dried basil.
Divide the filling among the wraps, fold the sides in and roll up.

recipes.name: Paprika & lime beef crispy potato plate with broccoli
steps: Dice the potatoes and boil until barely tender. Drain and pan-crisp them in a third of the oil.
Cut the broccoli into small florets, adding a splash of water to steam-fry it. Heat about a third of the oil in a wide pan and cook the vegetables until tender. Transfer to a plate.
Sear the beef strips in the remaining oil until cooked through.
Return the vegetables to the pan. Stir in the smoked paprika, warm for 30 seconds, then take off the heat and squeeze in the lime.
Plate the crispy potatoes and spoon over the topping.

Cut the carrot into fine matchsticks. Heat about a third of the oil in a wide pan and cook the vegetables until tender. Transfer to a plate.
Sear the beef strips in the remaining oil until cooked through.
Return the vegetables to the pan. Take the pan off the heat and toss the filling with lemon juice and dried basil.
Plate the crispy potatoes and spoon over the topping.

Slice the courgette into thin half-moons. Heat half the oil in a wide pan and cook the vegetables until tender. Transfer to a plate.
Sear the beef strips in the remaining oil until cooked through.
Return the vegetables to the pan. Grate the ginger into the pan and stir for a minute, then take off the heat and squeeze over lime juice.
Spoon the topping over the bulgur.

recipes.name: Paprika & lime salmon rice bowl with broccoli
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.

Slice the courgette into thin half-moons. Heat half the oil in a wide pan and cook the vegetables until tender. Transfer to a plate.
Pat the tofu dry, cube it and fry in the remaining oil until golden.
Return the vegetables to the pan. Crush the garlic into the pan, stir for 30 seconds, then pour in the passata and simmer for 5 minutes.
Fold the noodles through the pan and serve hot.

recipes.name: Paprika & lime tofu couscous bowl with broccoli
steps: Prepare the couscous with boiling water as directed on the packet, then fluff it with a fork.
Cut the broccoli into small florets, adding a splash of water to steam-fry it. Heat half the oil in a wide pan and cook the vegetables until tender. Transfer to a plate.
Pat the tofu dry, cube it and fry in the remaining oil until golden.
Return the vegetables to the pan. Stir in the smoked paprika, warm for 30 seconds, then take off the heat and squeeze in the lime.
Serve the topping over the couscous.

recipes.name: Paprika & lime tofu crispy potato plate with broccoli
steps: Dice the potatoes and boil until barely tender. Drain and pan-crisp them in a third of the oil.
Cut the broccoli into small florets, adding a splash of water to steam-fry it. Heat about a third of the oil in a wide pan and cook the vegetables until tender. Transfer to a plate.
Pat the tofu dry, cube it and fry in the remaining oil until golden.

Cut the broccoli into small florets, adding a splash of water to steam-fry it. Heat half the oil in a wide pan and cook the vegetables until tender. Transfer to a plate.
Pat the tofu dry, cube it and fry in the remaining oil until golden.
Return the vegetables to the pan. Simmer with the coconut milk for 5 minutes, then finish off the heat with lime juice.
Serve the topping with the quinoa.

Cut the carrot into fine matchsticks. Heat half the oil in a wide pan and cook the vegetables until tender. Transfer to a plate.
Pat the tofu dry, cube it and fry in the remaining oil until golden.
Return the vegetables to the pan. Simmer with the coconut milk for 5 minutes, then finish off the heat with lime juice.
Spoon the topping over the bulgur.

recipes.name: Paprika & lime chickpea rice bowl with broccoli
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.

Deseed and thinly slice the pepper. Heat half the oil in a wide pan and cook the vegetables until tender. Transfer to a plate.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then warm them in the remaining oil.
Return the vegetables to the pan. Stir in the smoked paprika, warm for 30 seconds, then take off the heat and squeeze in the lime.
Serve the topping with the quinoa.

Deseed and thinly slice the pepper. Heat half the oil in a wide pan and cook the vegetables until tender. Transfer to a plate.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then warm them in the remaining oil.
Return the vegetables to the pan. Stir in the cumin and paprika with a splash of water. Cook until the liquid has reduced.
Spoon the topping over the bulgur.

recipes.name: Paprika & lime chickpea bulgur bowl with courgette
steps: Simmer the bulgur until tender according to the packet. Drain any excess water.
Slice the courgette into thin half-moons. Heat half the oil in a wide pan and cook the vegetables until tender. Transfer to a plate.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then warm them in the remaining oil.
Return the vegetables to the pan. Stir in the smoked paprika, warm for 30 seconds, then take off the heat and squeeze in the lime.
Spoon the topping over the bulgur.
